headline: Jim Keller's startup Atomic Semi rebrands as 'Fab2'
summary: Jim Keller's startup builds small semiconductor fabs. Atomic Semi rebrands as Fab2.
details: Jim Keller's startup, Atomic Semi, has rebranded as 'Fab2'. The company aims to mass-produce small semiconductor fabs.
The rebranding underlines Fab2's intended role as a 'fab fab'.
Fab2 focuses on building a factory to produce small semiconductor fabs.

headline: MSI RTX 3060 12GB for $329.99, free shipping
summary: MSI Ventus 2X OC model back in stock at Newegg
details: The MSI GeForce RTX 3060 Ventus 2X 12 GB OC is a dual-fan variant with a 1087 MHz GPU boost clock. It features 12 GB of VRAM, making it suitable for running AI models locally and playing games at high resolutions.

This graphics card can handle most games at 1080p resolution, be quite competent at 1440p with fairly high detail levels, and even play many titles with aplomb at 4K with judicious care with settings.
The card is available at Newegg with free shipping for $329.99, a relatively affordable price for a graphics card with 12 GB of VRAM.
